dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Angelo is at risk due to behavioral concerns. Angelo has not acclimated well to the shelter enviornment and has displayed a high degree of leash biting, which has made walking him safely challenging. Once aroused, it has been difficult to redirect him even when offered treats or squeakers. In calmer settings, he will approach and jump on handlers with a loose body when off leash in the behavior office. He follows treats down but does not take them. On one occasion, Angelo became aroused on a walk after a stranger attempted to gain his attention and immediately began leash biting. When returning Angelo to his kennel, he has bitten and pulled leashes into the kennel. When trying to remove the lead from his kennel, Angelo will bite and pull tools into the kennel as well. Medically, Angelo is apparently healthy.

Angelo entered the care center as a stray, so we do not have any history on his behavior in a home environment. During his stay at the care center, Angelo has shown a low threshold for arousal, intensely biting and pulling on the leash when being leashed up and returned to his kennel. He has shown social behavior with staff, soliciting attention during his intake and medical examination, and approaching handlers with a loose body, jumping up in a social manner. Due to the high arousal behavior observed, we recommend that Angelo be placed in an adult-only home through a New Hope partner, who can provide positive reinforcement-based, force-free behavior modification.
